author: Hacktivism
body:
Honestly, this is one of the reasons why a lot of gamemodes aren't being played. Players can't be bothered to wait for thirteen others to join, before he/she can enjoy a match. Currently, you need fourteen players to start a DTM or CTW match, which is way too high in my opinion. It should be somewhere around four to six. Nowadays, you see one server with a ton of players, instead of five different servers with around ten players each. This means that when a server restarts, the first person who joins another server gets to pick the map that everyone plays. I've never seen someone join a CTW or TDM match and wait for players; it's always DTM.

TL;DR Change the minimum player count from fourteen to somewhere around four to six. 

Thoughts?
